answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to computationally scarce zero-knowledge proofs verified on-chain, creating a cryptographic oasis where fake agents cannot survive. Just as a river carves through stone by expending continuous kinetic energy, or a persistent zephyr requires atmospheric pressure gradients, an attacker must burn measurable economic work in cryptographic cycles for every forged identity. This operational cost scales linearly with population size, making mass infiltration economically unfeasible.
